# Appveyor

AppVeyor is a hosted continuous integration service for building and deploying applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/appveyor/.

## Actions

- **Get Build Artifacts**: Get the list of artifacts for a specific build job.
- **Get Environments**: Get a list of all deployment environments.
- **Get Projects**: Get a list of all projects for the authenticated account.
- **Get Role**: Retrieve details of a specific role.
- **Get Roles**: Retrieve all roles in the account.
- **Get Users**: Retrieve all users in the account.
